dct_description_sm:
This feature layer contains details of animal samples that tested positive for rabies in Manitoba since the province took over the rabies program on April 1, 2014. As of April 1, 2014, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) is no longer involved in managing rabies cases in Manitoba. The provincial Rabies Management Program is now coordinated by Manitoba Rabies Central, which is a collaborative effort involving the Manitoba departments of Health, Seniors and Long-Term Care, Agriculture, and Natural Resources and Indigenous Futures. Samples for rabies testing are requested by Manitoba Health, Seniors and Long-Term Care in the case of exposure of a human to a suspected rabid animal and by Agriculture in the case of exposure of another animal to a suspected rabid animal. Collection of a sample from the suspected rabid animal is coordinated by Manitoba Agriculture.

This information will be updated on a quarterly basis.
